commit.message:
chore(bump): mathlib fbc1661a3277 → 44f0a202c535 (2026-10-18), toolchain v4.36.0-rc1 (unchanged) (#8613)

Daily mathlib bump (64 upstream commits). 9 AINTLIB source files repaired:

- BernoulliRegular/Reflection/Kummer/DedekindSplitting.lean,
  ModularCurves/GroupScheme/MuN.lean: `Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_C`
  now takes the constant explicitly as `(a : R)` (was implicit `{r : R}`,
  #44691); pass `a` / rename the named argument `(r := …)` → `(a := …)`.
- HasseWeil/Foundation/Curves/Frobenius/FrobeniusFixedLocus.lean,
  HasseWeil/Isogeny/VerschiebungFactorization.lean: the
  `FiniteField.X_pow_card_sub_X_{ne_zero,natDegree_eq}` aliases now take the
  ring implicitly (#44691); use `Polynomial.X_pow_sub_X_ne_zero` /
  `Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_X` with `(R := L)`.
- HasseWeil/Foundation/Auxiliary/EllipticDivisibilitySequence.lean: mathlib
  now proves `IsEllipticSequence.normEDS` with the identical statement
  (#42453), so the local duplicate (and its private helper `map'`) is
  removed; mathlib's EDS file no longer re-exports `Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith`,
  so import it directly.
- BernoulliRegular/Reflection/WeakSplitting/Factorization.lean:
  `Ideal.absNorm` now has junk value `0` at `⊥` (#44698) and is no longer
  definitionally `cardQuot`; use the new `Ideal.absNorm_eq_natCard`.
- BernoulliRegular/.../ZModFold/FiniteCharacterFold.lean: after the
  `WittVector.mk'` removal (#43374) `simp only` reduces
  `(WittVector.mk ℓ f).coeff 0` by projection, leaving `coeff (0 + s)`;
  simp with `zero_add` instead of the now-unused `hcoord`.
- BernoulliRegular/.../CoordinatePeel/CarryFreeTailEquality.lean (×2),
  BernoulliRegular/.../InversePeel/FrobeniusReindexedTail.lean: the
  preceding `rw` now closes the goal; drop the trailing `simp`.

No statement changes. Full-coverage gate (/home/chris/bin/aintlib-build-all.sh,
2799 modules): only the known #8574 closure fails (OrdPipeline,
InvertibleSheafGlueEffectivity); the other 2779 modules build, and all 12
lean_lib targets build. Code-only sorry/admit/native_decide counts
unchanged: 256 / 0 / 10.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
